For c(p−1)K>1, H_c′(K)<0 reverses a prior strict pair exchange near K in a 3-season schedule; no 2-season reversal. Independently exact-rational replay gave ascending 29953800/29691601 and swapped 246402/243049 with positive difference 35828733402/7216513931449.
